Antigravity x Hermes Core

Bring the NousResearch Hermes Agent closed learning loop into Google Antigravity.

Persistent bounded memory, SQLite FTS5 cross-session recall, and self-curating skills in one zero-dependency Python plugin.

Quick start · Architecture · Screenshots · Pitfalls · Zero-clone prompt · Agent spec · Verification · Benchmark

python install.py --mode standalone

Every new chat in Google Antigravity starts blank. `hermes-core` injects your curated `MEMORY.md` and `USER.md` snapshot, a digest of your last five conversations, incremental SQLite FTS5 cross-room search, and self-curating skills via one stdlib Python plugin, an MCP server, and four lifecycle hooks. ```mermaid --- config: look: handDrawn --- flowchart TD START["New Antigravity Chat"] --> H_START["Hook: SessionStart"] H_START -->|"Inject frozen snapshot"| AGENT["Antigravity Agent Turn"] subgraph HOOKS["Lifecycle Hooks (hooks_runner.py)"] H_START H_PRE["PreInvocation + PostToolUse (count turns and tools)"] H_STOP["Stop Hook (nudge at 10 turns or 15 tools)"] end AGENT -->|"Every turn and tool call"| H_PRE AGENT -->|"End of turn"| H_STOP H_STOP -->|"Review due (continue once)"| AGENT subgraph MCP["MCP Server (hermes-core_hermes-core)"] T_MEM["memory (status, add, patch, remove, batch, backups)"] T_SEARCH["session_search (discover, scroll, read, browse)"] T_SKILL["skill_manage (create, patch, pin, usage, curate, restore)"] end AGENT <--> T_MEM AGENT <--> T_SEARCH AGENT <--> T_SKILL subgraph STORE["Local Persistence (Standalone or Shared Hermes)"] S_MEM["MEMORY.md + USER.md + 15 rolling backups"] S_FTS["SQLite WAL + FTS5 (transcript.jsonl + optional state.db RO)"] S_SKILLS["skills/ + .usage.json + skills.json registry"] end T_MEM <--> S_MEM T_SEARCH <--> S_FTS T_SKILL <--> S_SKILLS S_MEM -.->|"Read on session start"| H_START S_FTS -.->|"Last 5 sessions digest"| H_START S_SKILLS -.->|"Curator preview"| H_START ``` --- ## Quick start (zero manual setup) You do not need to install extra packages or configure JSON by hand. Pick any of the three routes below. ### Option A: Paste this GitHub URL into Antigravity (recommended) Open Antigravity and paste this prompt: ```text https://github.com/vexahostdev/antigravity-architectur-hermes-agent Clone or fetch this repository, follow INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md, ask me the 3 setup questions first, install hermes-core, and run tests/verify_all.py before finishing. ``` ### Option B: Zero-clone copy-paste prompt If you do not want to clone a repo at all, copy the self-contained build prompt in [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md) and paste it directly into Antigravity. The agent will ask your setup preferences, generate all 8 Python modules, register the plugin, and run the isolated test suite. ### Option C: One-command local install On Windows, use `python` instead of `python3`. ```bash git clone https://github.com/vexahostdev/antigravity-architectur-hermes-agent.git cd antigravity-architectur-hermes-agent python3 install.py --mode standalone --scratch-dir ~/antigravity-scratch --projects-dir ~/Projects python3 tests/verify_all.py ``` Already running Hermes Agent on the same machine? Point `install.py` at your existing `~/.hermes` (or `%LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes`) directory so Antigravity and Hermes share memories, skills, and read-only `state.db` history live: ```bash python3 install.py --mode shared --scratch-dir ~/antigravity-scratch ``` Re-running `install.py` upgrades server modules without overwriting a customized `rules/AGENTS.md` (pass `--force-rules` to back up and reset it). If another memory plugin (such as `personal-memory`) is already installed in Antigravity, disable it under **Customizations -> Installed** so `SessionStart` does not inject duplicate memory blocks. Then open a **New Chat** so the plugin, MCP server, hooks, and skills load into your session. ### Uninstall ```bash python3 install.py --uninstall # Keeps standalone memories/ and skills/ python3 install.py --uninstall --purge-data # Removes everything cleanly ``` --- ## Architecture specs & honest scope | Spec | Value | | :--- | :--- | | External dependencies | `0` pip packages (Python 3.10+ stdlib only) | | Runtime components | `8` Python modules, `3` MCP tools, `4` lifecycle hooks | | Memory bounds | `MEMORY.md` 2,200 chars, `USER.md` 1,375 chars, `15` rolling backups per store | | Recall index | SQLite WAL + FTS5 (`sessions_fts.db`), optional read-only Hermes `state.db` bridge | | Skill Curator | `14d` stale threshold, `30d` archive threshold, `.tar.gz` backups before edits/archives | | Review nudges | Inline `Stop` hook every `10` turns or `15` tool calls (fail-open on error) | Most comparisons skip the boundaries. Here is what actually runs inside Antigravity and what stays outside it. | Hermes Agent capability | Status in Antigravity | How it works | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Bounded curated memory (`MEMORY.md` 2,200 chars, `USER.md` 1,375 chars) | Full parity | `memory` MCP tool (`status`, `add`, `patch`, `remove`, `batch`, `backups`), `§` delimiter, cross-platform locks, 15 rolling backups before writes. | | Frozen session-start injection | Full parity | `SessionStart` hook injects live `MEMORY.md`, `USER.md`, and a digest of your 5 most recent conversations without breaking prompt caching. | | Cross-session SQLite FTS5 recall | Full parity | `session_search` indexes Antigravity `transcript.jsonl` files incrementally into WAL+FTS5 (`discover`, `scroll`, `read`, `browse`). Indexed text survives even if you delete a room in the UI. | | Self-improving skills and Curator | Full parity | `skill_manage` (`list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `patch`, `pin`, `unpin`, `usage`, `curate`, `restore`) synced to `.usage.json` (`14d` stale, `30d` archive, `.tar.gz` snapshots) and registered via `~/.gemini/config/skills.json`. | | Security scanning and redaction | Full parity | Dual-scope `threat_scanner.py` blocks prompt injections, bidi Unicode tricks, SSH backdoors, and hardcoded secrets. `redact_secrets()` masks tokens in search snippets. | | Learning loop review nudges | Inline hook | `PreInvocation` + `PostToolUse` track turns and tool calls. `Stop` triggers `[Hermes Learning Loop Review]` at 10 turns or 15 tool calls (inline instead of a background thread). | | Goals, cron, subagents, workflows | Native Antigravity | Handled natively by `/goal`, `/schedule`, subagents/`swarm`, `run_workflow`, `/learn`, and `/compact`. | | 24/7 Telegram / WhatsApp / Discord gateway | External daemon | Antigravity is a desktop/CLI client. If you need 24/7 messaging bots, keep a standalone Hermes gateway running on a VPS and sync `memories/` and `skills/`. | --- ## What gets installed ```text ~/.gemini/config/ ├── config.json # Enables hermes-core ├── skills.json # Absolute paths + exact hidden folder excludes └── plugins/ └── hermes-core/ ├── plugin.json ├── mcp_config.json # Stdio MCP server: hermes-core_hermes-core ├── hooks.json # SessionStart, PreInvocation, PostToolUse, Stop ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md # SOUL.md directness + learning loop instructions ├── server/ │ ├── common.py # Paths, cross-platform locks, atomic writes, redactor │ ├── threat_scanner.py # Dual-scope strict/skill security scanner │ ├── memory_store.py # Bounded MEMORY.md/USER.md + 15 rolling backups │ ├── fts_indexer.py # SQLite WAL+FTS5 indexer + optional Hermes state.db RO bridge │ ├── skill_curator.py # .usage.json telemetry, pins, .tar.gz curator backups │ ├── skill_manager.py # Skill CRUD + skills.json absolute-path sync │ ├── hermes_mcp.py # Zero-dep JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP server │ └── hooks_runner.py # Fail-open lifecycle hook dispatcher └── data/ ├── plugin_settings.json # standalone or shared mode config ├── sessions_fts.db # Local FTS5 index └── hook_state.json # Per-conversation counters (7-day TTL) ``` --- ## Live screenshots Captured from a live Antigravity session with `hermes-core` active (private sidebars and custom brand names blurred). | New chat auto-memory recall | Cross-session FTS5 search | | :---: | :---: | | ![New Chat Memory](assets/screenshots/01-new-chat-memory.png) | ![Cross-Session Recall](assets/screenshots/02-cross-session-search.png) | | **Plugin active in Customizations** | **Skill usage telemetry (`usage`)** | | ![Plugins Installed](assets/screenshots/03-plugins-installed.png) | ![Skill Usage](assets/screenshots/04-skill-usage.png) | **Skill Curator dry-run preview (`curate`, `dry_run=true`)** ![Skill Curator Preview](assets/screenshots/05-curator-preview.png) --- ## Real-world Antigravity fixes baked in Building this surfaced six non-obvious Antigravity behaviors (double-namespaced `hermes-core_hermes-core` MCP IDs, `skills.json` rejecting `~/` and regex excludes, plugin scanners skipping directory junctions, Windows `msvcrt` zero-byte lock traps, `Stop` hook `continuationActive` loops, and dual-scope strict/skill security scanning). Read the full breakdown in [docs/ANTIGRAVITY_PITFALLS.md](docs/ANTIGRAVITY_PITFALLS.md). --- ## Verification Run the isolated test suite anytime without touching live user memories, skills, or configs: ```bash python3 tests/verify_all.py ``` It exercises `install.py` (deployment, upgrade rule preservation, and `--uninstall`), MCP JSON-RPC calls, memory bounds and 15-file backup rotation, FTS5 search/redaction/deletion survival, skill CRUD/pinning/curator backups/restore, and all four lifecycle hooks inside a temporary directory. --- ## Recall & latency benchmark SQLite WAL + FTS5 `session_search` latency and speedup vs. raw JSONL transcript scanning across 100 to 10,000 messages (5 to 500 rooms), while Stock Antigravity starts every New Chat with 0% cross-room recall. ```mermaid --- config: look: handDrawn --- xychart-beta title "FTS5 session_search Speedup vs Raw JSONL Scan (x faster)" x-axis ["100 msgs", "500 msgs", "1k msgs", "2.5k msgs", "5k msgs", "10k msgs"] y-axis "Speedup (x faster)" 0 --> 70 line [0.8, 3.7, 7.0, 18.2, 29.8, 64.3] ``` | Messages | Sessions (rooms) | FTS5 `session_search` | Raw JSONL scan | Speedup | Exact recall | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 100 | 5 | 1.65 ms | 1.25 ms | 0.8x | 100% | | 500 | 25 | 1.69 ms | 6.21 ms | 3.7x | 100% | | 1,000 | 50 | 1.79 ms | 12.51 ms | 7.0x | 100% | | 2,500 | 125 | 1.68 ms | 30.52 ms | 18.2x | 100% | | 5,000 | 250 | 2.20 ms | 65.68 ms | 29.8x | 100% | | 10,000 | 500 | 1.94 ms | 124.75 ms | 64.3x | 100% | Reproduce locally in an isolated temporary directory: `python3 tests/benchmark.py` (use `python` on Windows). --- ## Attribution & License Architecture inspired by [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) (MIT License). Google Antigravity and Hermes Agent marks belong to their respective owners. Licensed under [MIT](LICENSE).
